## Methodology

Boab uses the ASD LATICE rubric. The priority score is computed as:

priority = round(algo_vuln * 0.30 + hndl * 0.30 + data_sens * 0.15 + sys_crit * 0.15 + mig_diff * 0.10, 1)

Triage tier 1 indicates an asset that must be migrated within the 2028 milestone window. Tier 2 fits comfortably inside the 2028 milestone, tier 3 within the 2029 to 2030 window, and tier 4 requires monitoring only.

Refer to the ASD Information Security Manual for control mappings. Boab does not map to specific ISM control IDs in v1; that work is on the v1.1 backlog.
